items.title: ephemeral
items.body: adj. 转瞬即逝的，朝生暮死的。专八高频文学词汇，常用来形容社交媒体时代的注意力、网红热点或春日樱花。写作替换词：transient / fleeting。例句：In the age of short videos, our attention span has become increasingly ephemeral.

items.title: quintessential
items.body: adj. 最典型的；精髓的；完美的典范。常搭配 the quintessential example of… 用来形容某人是某种特质的集大成者。例句：She is the quintessential professional—always punctual, prepared, and poised under pressure.

items.title: Could you run that by me again?
items.body: 请求对方重复一遍的母语级表达，比 Pardon? 或 Repeat 更自然礼貌。适用于会议没听清、网速卡了、对方语速太快等场景。语调在 run 和 by 处轻微上扬，注意连读：run-that-by。

items.title: I’m down for whatever.
items.body: “我随意/奉陪/都行”，表达随和、愿意配合的态度。down 在这里表示“乐意参与”，比 I don’t care 积极得多。类似表达：I’m game / I’m in。例句：A: Thai or Italian? B: I’m down for whatever.

items.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
items.body: Don’t ever let somebody tell you you can’t do something. Not even me. You got a dream, you gotta protect it. People can’t do something themselves, they wanna tell you you can’t do it. —— 这段演讲式台词适合练连读与弱读，特别是 wanna / gotta 的口语缩读，以及保护梦想主题的议论文引用。

items.title: Zootopia
items.body: Life’s a little bit messy. We all make mistakes. No matter what type of animal you are, change starts with you. —— 日常口语中 Life’s 的省音、连读典范；a little bit 的弱读练习重点。句意适合自我激励与写作结尾升华。
